XData.name: DTL
XData.Data: <transform sourceClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' targetClass='IHC.ITF.Request.EdwRequest' sourceDocType='EadLegacyAdtHl7:EadLegacyAdt' create='new' language='objectscript' > <annotation>DTL for EdwAndRods hl7 Adt to RODS interface</annotation> <trace value='"#### In the DTL #####"' /> <assign value='source.{MSH:SendingFacility.namespaceID}' property='target.FCILTYCD' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientIdentifierList().ID}' property='target.EMPIOBFUSCATEDTXT' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{DG1():DiagnosisCodeDG1.identifier}' property='target.CHIEFCOMPLAINTCD' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{DG1():DiagnosisDescription}' property='target.CHIEFCOMPLAINTTX' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:DateTimeOfBirth.degreeofprecision}' property='target.AGE' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PV1:PatientType}' property='target.ENCOUNTERNOOBFUSCATEDTXT' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:Sex}' property='target.GENDERCD' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PV1:AdmitDateTime.timeofanevent}' property='timeEvent' action='set' /> <if condition='$length(timeEvent) > 8' > <true> <assign value='$extract(timeEvent,1,8)' property='target.OBSERVATIONDTS' action='set' /> </true> </if> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientAddress().ziporpostalcode}' property='target.ZIPCD' action='set' /> <assign value='$extract($zstrip($ZDATETIME($ZTIMESTAMP,3,1,4), "*P"),1,8)' property='target.EDWINSERTEDDTS' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{ZID(1):EmpiNumber}' property='target.EMPI' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{ZID(1):AccountNumber}' property='target.ENCOUNTERNO' action='set' /> <trace value='"#### DTL...end #####"' /> </transform>
